message.content: "Young Blood" was performed by the Beatles (notably at the Decca audition and on BBC radio), but it's a cover — written by Jerry Leiber, Mike Stoller, and Doc Pomus.
message.reasoning_content: "Young Blood" — Beatles sang it at Decca auditions / BBC; it's Leiber/Stoller. Also "Bad Boy"? "Young Blood" performed on Live at the BBC, written by Leiber, Stoller, Pomus.
